mappings.name: resource-consistency
mappings.limitation: Shared-rule diagnostics require exact check/target attribution. Capture supplemental owning-rule diagnostics before suppression separately; do not add them to configured raw counts.

mappings.name: put-resource-marker
mappings.limitation: Marker metadata is distinct from canonical resource registration. Resource-shaped prioritization is not proof of a service defect.

assessmentScope.audience: ARM production plus explicitly evaluated immutable ARM staging Spectral supplement
assessmentScope.generalManyToMany: not executed; separate supported explicit mappings with no cross-product attribution or group-level equivalence inference
assessmentScope.suppressionAccounting: Count captured responsible-rule diagnostics as covered checks even when authored suppressions prevent configured warnings; retain both quantities.

activation.assessment: Worker explicitly enables each mapping's selected rules; do not present marker findings as shared-profile default warnings.

specFollowup.scope: Separate authoring follow-ups; no edits to the frozen 487-project corpus and no unchanged-corpus coverage credit for modified specs.

missingCreateAssociations.change: Three explicit @armResourceCreateOrUpdate decorators; preserve low-level templates, all request/response DTOs, client.tsp files and suppressions.
missingCreateAssociations.registration: Compiler probes: absent before for all three; present afterward for all three; HTTP methods and routes unchanged.
missingCreateAssociations.publicCodeModelCompatibility: Ten language-specific TCGC outputs unchanged except one top-level source-content crossLanguageVersion fingerprint per file.
missingCreateAssociations.sdkCompatibilityLimit: Full SDK generation not performed. Exported public TCGC data omits internal __raw metadata; specialized ARM SDK resource recognition can intentionally change and needs owner review.
missingCreateAssociations.frozenCorpusStatus: Still a modeling dependency; the draft source change is not present in the assessed frozen specs.

parentChildAssociations.cause: Legacy.CreateOrUpdateAsync associates the child endpoint operation with ApiManagementServiceResource while its body is PrivateEndpointConnectionRequest and its 200 response is the common private-endpoint connection model.
parentChildAssociations.recommendedFollowup: Rebind to the existing PrivateEndpointConnection child using a source operation that preserves the original parent instance parameters, explicit child path parameter, custom request DTO and all success/LRO/error responses. Consider a low-level Foundations.ArmCreateOperation with explicit child registration if the specialized template cannot preserve the custom request.
parentChildAssociations.rejectedShortcut: Changing only the legacy Resource template argument changes generated route parameters. The specialized PrivateEndpoints create template does not expose an independent Request parameter; adding a second decorator leaves the inherited parent registration in place.
parentChildAssociations.requiredGate: Before proposing a patch, compile before/after and compare every emitted OpenAPI version including routes, operation IDs, parameter order, common references and LRO metadata; inspect language code-model/ARM SDK effects. Verify whether the common response alias and local canonical child need an emission-neutral alignment.
parentChildAssociations.status: Prepared but not authored or claimed wire-compatible; owner/compatibility work remains. Do not compare the DTO to the parent or count a parent warning as the original child comparison.

parentChildAssociations.cause: Certificate upload uses Legacy.CreateOrUpdateSync<Vault, CertificateRequest> but returns VaultCertificateResponse at the certificates child route.
parentChildAssociations.recommendedFollowup: Confirm whether the certificate endpoint is a resource create or a legacy upload/command. If it is a child resource, establish its actual canonical model and preserve the existing DTOs and route while registering that child; otherwise model the existing operation role without inventing fields or changing PUT to POST.
parentChildAssociations.requiredGate: Service/SDK-owner confirmation of the operation role, followed by all-version emitted-contract and generated-client compatibility checks before any source PR.
parentChildAssociations.status: No proven canonical certificate child has been established. Prepared decision dependency, not an accepted equality exception or a completed source fix.

syncJobDependency.cause: Neither compared operation has a proven canonical SyncJob resource association in the frozen inspection. PUT returns read-only name/type/id; GET omits name/type, has writable id and adds exception under properties.
syncJobDependency.recommendedFollowup: Establish the canonical SyncJob child and whether summary/detail response differences are the intended wire contract. Reuse bounded canonical success-body checks only after correct associations exist.
syncJobDependency.status: A genuine unresolved response-consistency context. New warnings against a SourceControl parent, marker warnings, and focused generic DTO tests are not proof that this PUT/GET comparison is covered.
